description: chapter_lines: story-only thanks spoken by the contact, with the errand's 5–16 GP payment. milestones: story rewards granted after each act.

entries.text: There will always be a place for you by my fire.
Ask for me by name in any town along this route, and doors will open.
Your names will be spoken kindly in every tavern from here to the coast.
I owe you a favor now, and I keep my debts.
I know a sealed cellar nobody has opened in years. Ask me when you are rested.
Come back at winter's end. I may have work worth your steel.
I will vouch for you to anyone who matters in this region.
On your next journey, I will send word ahead that you are friends.
Rest here as long as you like. There is stew, and there are beds.
There is talk of trouble farther along. Come and hear it when you can.
You have friends here now, whether you wanted them or not.
When the old story is told, I will make sure your part is not forgotten.
